O.outcome_detail: identification of additional or different areas of need

cells.quote: Interestingly, coach-identified deficits differed (including identification of additional deficits) from those identified by the PD or learner in 79%.

cells.quote: Clinical reasoning was the most common reason for referral followed by medical knowledge, while interpersonal skills and communication was the most identified need by the coaches followed by clinical reasoning.
cells.note: The study reports differing rankings of needs, not a tested difference in educational or clinical outcomes.

O.outcome_detail: Number and proportion of identified QT master's programs

cells.quote: In 2021, 24 of the currently running master’s programs were established (27.9%), whilst in each of 2022 and 2023, 16 master’s programs were established (18.6%). A total of 72.1% of all the currently running master’s programs began since the start of 2021, despite only representing a three year timeframe.
cells.note: Descriptive comparison of program establishment dates; not a causal instructional effect.

D.comparison: Programs established up to and including 2019

O.outcome_detail: Fraction of programs run by joint faculties

cells.quote: The number of programs run by Joint Faculties has almost doubled from 2019, from representing 22.7% of all programs established up to and including 2019, to 39,5% of those existing up to and including 2024, as reflected in Figure 8.
cells.note: Descriptive temporal comparison of program organization.

cells.quote: Prior to 2019, none of the established programs offered internships in companies, whilst as of 2020 greater than 50% of newly launched program’s offer an industry internship.
cells.note: Descriptive temporal comparison of internship provision; the text does not report an instructional learning outcome.

O.outcome_detail: Projected career destinations reported by coordinators and websites

cells.quote: Only 17.6% of the career outcomes indicated by program websites and coordinators refer to academic career paths, while 82.3% refer to industry careers.
cells.note: These are projected outcomes reported by program organizers, not graduate follow-up data: “it is not necessarily based on follow-up studies conducted with graduates.”
